paper.title_en: Are Black Hole and Cosmological Horizon Thermodynamics Necessarily Inequivalent?
paper.abstract_en: It has recently been argued that cosmological horizon thermodynamics and black hole thermodynamics are generically inequivalent in any consistent, UV complete theory of quantum gravity, where it was suggested that this could be falsified by the identification of a counterexample. This conjecture was motivated in part by noting that cosmological horizons do not incorporate many of the convenient features found in the black holes described by string theory. In this work, we consider as a toy model a universe with a single non-rotating black hole and a positive cosmological constant. We work in the Nariai limit where the mass of the black hole is taken to its maximum possible value, and where we also assert that the quantum field theory living on this background is strictly parity invariant. In the semi-classical regime where we neglect instability of the exact Nariai equilibrium under quantum fluctuations, we find that the observer cannot readily distinguish the physics in the neighborhood of the black hole horizon from the physics in the neighborhood of the cosmological horizon. This does not prove that the two are generically equivalent in any universe, though it does suggest that they cannot be entirely unrelated in general. We propose that any consistent theory of quantum gravity that aims to describe black holes in a universe with a positive cosmological constant should provide a related microscopic origin for the leading semiclassical cosmological entropy and black hole entropy in the neighborhood of the particular limit considered here.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接探讨黑洞热力学与宇宙学视界热力学的等价性猜想，在Nariai极限下用半经典方法构造反例式论证，属于量子引力与黑洞热力学交叉的理论工作，理论深度较高，值得研究者进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞热力学与宇宙学视界热力学必然不等价吗？
decision.abstract_zh: 最近有人提出，在任何一致的、紫外完备的量子引力理论中，宇宙学视界热力学与黑洞热力学通常是（generically）不等价的；并提出，若找到一个反例即可否证该猜想。该猜想的部分动机在于注意到：宇宙学视界并不具备弦论所描述的黑洞所具有的许多便利特征。在本工作中，我们考虑一个作为玩具模型的宇宙：其中含有一个不旋转的黑洞以及一个正宇宙学常数。我们在Nariai极限下工作，即把黑洞质量取为其最大可能值，并且我们还假设生活在该背景上的量子场论是严格宇称不变的。在半经典区域——即我们忽略精确Nariai平衡态在量子涨落下的不稳定性——我们发现，观测者不能轻易地区分黑洞视界邻域的物理与宇宙学视界邻域的物理。这并不能证明二者在任何宇宙中通常等价（generically equivalent），但确实暗示二者一般而言不可能完全无关。我们提出：任何旨在描述正宇宙学常数宇宙中黑洞的一致量子引力理论，都应当为此处所考虑的特定极限邻域中的领头半经典宇宙学熵与黑洞熵提供一个相关的微观起源。
